remarks.value:
Most of the structures contained in ICSD are published in journals, only a few entries were
submitted as private communications. If you are a registered user of the ICSD database (Inorganic Crystal Structure Database), you will also find the deposited inorganic crystal structure data sets from 'Crystal Structure Depot' = r3d100010237 in this database, with a short production-dependent delay. The records in ICSD are produced from the original publication and the deposited data and have the advantage of having undergone additional checking.
